title: Dresden Zwinger
axis: Positive X runs from the Wallpavillon toward the Glockenspielpavillon. Positive Z runs from Semper Gallery toward the Kronentor and its moat bridge.

controls.method: Standard viewer terrain and rendered PMTiles water and path heights at the mapped crossing.

limits: Mapped footprints, the moat crossing and courtyard basin outlines set the site fit. Pavilion profiles and stone details are reconstructed from visible exterior photographs.
Garden surfaces follow the restored courtyard layout. Fountain plumbing, sculptural likenesses and room interiors are outside this exterior model.
The viewer supplies terrain, mapped water and surrounding streets. The model includes low perimeter stones, terrace paving and the covered pedestrian route through the Kronentor.
